scrims.description: Scrim list, per-map result entry, and round flow.
items: Create a scrim: opponent, format (e.g. 232), schedule, ruleset in use
Game slots follow the format quota; each slot picks a mode from what's left
Report Scores: map result, score, and per-mode player stat table
Stat columns follow the mode — Hardpoint and Control have a Time column
Auto-fill from a scoreboard screenshot
Map Flow: SnD rounds, Hardpoint hills, Control rounds

roster.description: Players per roster, their roles, and their stats.
items: Add a player: IGN, UID, aliases for scoreboard matching
Weapon class roles each player declares
Mark substitutes and inactive players
Compact stat card per player
Link a player to an account so they can fill in their own loadout

loadouts.description: Each player's loadout, checked against the active ruleset.
items: Pick weapon, attachments, perks, lethal, tactical, operator skill, scorestreaks
Violating items are marked red with the reason
Warning when two teammates share an operator skill
Weapon class role pool check: 3 AR / 3 SMG / 1 LMG / 1 Shotgun / 1 Marksman / 1 Sniper
Team compliance panel: 5 players by category matrix

rules.description: Upload the tournament ruleset, review how it was read, then activate it.
items: Upload a ruleset image or PDF
AI parsing results are marked as a draft needing review
Review per category: weapons, attachments, perks, utility, operator skills, scorestreaks, cosmetics
Per-mode lobby settings and map pool
Search: type an item name to see whether it is allowed or banned
Activate the ruleset — used by every scrim pointing to it

formats.description: The format code sets how many maps each mode gets. Play order is free.
items: List of existing formats and their game counts

Head-to-head against a specific opponent
Maps with positive K/D that were still lost

Score flow: hill by hill, round by round

Recorded opponents
Weeks as review periods
Account language preference
